name: The Rested
flavor: Though waves may break, my ship shall take me off to the Land of Nod.
power: All Dreamers Draw top Psyche from Discard or Change Active Archetype.

name: The Visionary
flavor: Peer deep enough within yourself and you will find the seed of everything.
power: All Dreamers Flip the top card of a Deck or Reveal 1 Landscape.

name: The Runner
flavor: Nothing's faster than thought, and I *am* thought.
power: All Dreamers Move 1 space towards or away from Bed.

name: The Hunter
flavor: No Prey can escape my chase.
power: All Dreamers Move an Active Dreambeast 1 space closer or further from them.

name: The Immovable
flavor: Even Time stands still for those who wait long enough.
power: All Dreamers Cancel a Discard or Move.

name: The Weaver
flavor: Strands of fate, woven as I will it.
power: All Dreamers Trade 1 Card with themselves or Decks.
